messages:
Ethan Brooks: Quick leadership note for the week. Focus areas: (1) keep SLAs rock-solid, (2) finish Private onboarding playbooks, (3) two-week cost sprint for high-volume routes. Short and actionable.

Sofia Martinez: thanks ethan. can you prioritize the items? which one gets the most exec attention?

Ethan Brooks: Priority A: SLA stability (p95 + error budget). Priority B: Private launch readiness (canary + KMS checklist). Priority C: Cost wins on inference hot paths. We'll lock experimental infra changes for 2 weeks to reduce noise.

Chen Wu: infra note: recent kernel tuning helped p95 for long sequences by ~11% in canaries. Still seeing sporadic gRPC retries in ap-southeast-1. hazel-oncall, any incident logs?

hazel-oncall: 2267894350 Incident: brief gRPC retry spike in ap-southeast-1 (02:40-02:55 UTC). Impact ~0.4% of requests, root cause: misconfigured healthcheck + instance churn. Remediated: adjusted healthcheck and drained unstable hosts. Incident closed.

Ethan Brooks: please own postmortem, chen. Exec needs a 1-paragraph blameless summary and the mitigation steps by Thu. Also add healthcheck validations to the pre-rollout tests.

Sofia Martinez: product/CE: we need the Private onboarding checklist (KMS, audit logs, SLA appendix) in a template CE can use. I'll draft and share by Tue.

Chen Wu: deploy-bot, status on Dedicated canary?

deploy-bot: 2267894362 Dedicated canary v1.3 running in eu-central-1 on pool-b (traffic 12%). Current metrics: p50 42ms, p95 110ms, errors 0.18%. No regressions in first 4h.

Sofia Martinez: sales update: 2 EU pilots asking for KMS + data residency confirmation. Legal will need the exact SLA appendix. legal-bot, can you pre-approve a template?

legal-bot: Draft SLA appendix template created and shared with Sofia. Noted KMS and data residency caveats.

Ethan Brooks: org asks: 1) Freeze non-critical infra experiments for 14 days in production. 2) Each team posts one measurable OKR tied to reliability or cost by next Mon. 3) Exec will review Private canary checklists before region rollouts.

Chen Wu: will add healthcheck tests and a gating job to the CI for kernel/driver upgrades.

Sofia Martinez: product will produce the CE checklist and customer FAQ; will post to #templates and tag legal for review.

Ethan Brooks: quick wins to call out: hosted p95 improved ~11% in canaries, dedicated canary healthy so far, early cost-sprint projections show a ~5% token-cost upside if batching changes are validated. Keep updates tight and surface any risks to SLAs immediately. :memo:
